institute.name: NMKRV Pre-University College, Jayanagar
institute.trust: Rashtreeya Sikshana Samithi Trust (RSST) / RV Educational Institutions (RVEI)
institute.address: Jayanagar, Bengaluru / DPS Bengaluru North Campus, Survey No. 35/1A, Sathnur Village, Bagalur Post, Off Bellary Road, Jalla Hobli, Bengaluru – 562149, Karnataka, India

leadership.founder: Sri M.C. Sivananda Sarma (80+ years legacy under RSST)

courses.medium: English (Board examinations may be answered in English or Kannada)

combinations.subjects: Business Studies, Accountancy, Basic Mathematics, Statistics
Business Studies, Accountancy, Basic Mathematics, Economics

process: Application forms available online via admission portal and at campus office post SSLC/10th results.
Submit application with 4 passport photographs & attested copy of Class 10 marksheet.
Admissions finalized on merit and first-come, first-served basis.
required_documents: SSLC / 10th Standard Original Marks Card + attested photocopies
Provisional Eligibility Certificate (issued by DPUE Bengaluru for foreign/NRI applicants)
Caste Certificate issued by Tahsildar (SC/ST/Category candidates)
Income Certificate (if family annual income is below ₹44,500)

examination_rules.i_puc: Promotional examination conducted at district level by DPUE (Minimum 30% per paper and 35% aggregate to advance).
examination_rules.ii_puc: Annual State Board Examination conducted by Karnataka DPUE.

items: Modern Classrooms equipped with Digital Learning Aids & Projectors
Comprehensive Library with Textbooks, Reference Books, Journals & E-Resources
Specialized Physics, Chemistry, and Biology Laboratories
High-tech Computer Science Laboratory with high-speed internet
Sports Facilities for Indoor and Outdoor Games (Basketball, Football, Volleyball, Badminton)

faculty.teaching_staff: Faculty details are managed internally. The college has experienced Senior Lecturers and Lecturers across Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Computer Science, Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics, Statistics, English, Kannada, Hindi, and Sanskrit departments.
faculty.note: Individual faculty listings are not currently published on the website (department tabs are placeholder-only as of scraping date).
